parties: Hero MotoCorp Limited and Ather Energy Limited
headline: Hero MotoCorp investment in Ather Energy disclosed under Regulation 30
sum: Hero MotoCorp has made an investment/acquisition in Ather Energy Limited, disclosed via NSE Regulation 30 filing on 25 August 2026 as a material corporate event requiring immediate disclosure.
implication: Regulation 30 filing signals a material transaction below the statutory threshold for shareholder approval but material enough for stock exchange announcement; precedent for two-wheeler manufacturers entering EV mobility startups via minority/significant stake acquisition.
detail: The disclosure was filed pursuant to SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations 2015, Regulation 30, indicating Hero MotoCorp has updated its investment position in Ather Energy Limited. Ather Energy is a Bangalore-based electric two-wheeler and charging infrastructure startup. The transaction structure and valuation were disclosed in the NSE filing but the full details are contained in the attached document referenced in the disclosure.

framework.ref: SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, Regulation 30
framework.note: Mandatory immediate disclosure of material events by listed companies; defines 'material' at ₹10 cr or 5% of market cap.
Board approval for investments in other companies (applies if >25% value of assets or material amount).
Limitations on loans/investments by a company in other entities; consent thresholds for members.

framework.ref: Foreign Exchange Management Act, 1999 (if cross-border element)
framework.note: If transaction involves overseas investor or offshore capital, FEMA compliance required.
Acquisition triggers CCI review if parties' assets or turnover breach statutory thresholds.
If Ather is in financial distress or restructuring, IBC provisions may apply.
Capital gains exemption on acquisition of stake in unlisted company (if applicable).

conditions: Likely board-level approval by Hero MotoCorp
Possible CCI review if thresholds crossed
structure.novel: Strategic investment by mature two-wheeler OEM into promising EV startup in India's transitioning mobility ecosystem; signals Hero's pivot toward electric vehicles post-ICE maturity.

triggers.note: Mandatory disclosure within 30 minutes of Board decision; investment in listed/material entity
If combined asset base or turnover of parties breaches ₹2,000 cr threshold, CCI approval required
Board/Shareholder approval for capex or investment above threshold limits
